posts.problem: Large fact-table join with GROUP BY is slow because it touches most rows in statistic_detail.
required_preparation: Create country_detail and statistic_detail in the target MySQL database.
Load approximately the same scale or a smaller but still large synthetic statistic_detail dataset.
Keep the join/group-by indexes close to the post if strict reproduction is desired.

actions.sql: SELECT c.country_name AS country_name FROM statistic_detail AS s INNER JOIN country_detail AS c ON s.country = c.country_code GROUP BY 1

posts.problem: Deleting the active MySQL slow query log file does not recreate it until FLUSH SLOW LOGS because mysqld keeps writing to an open file descriptor.
required_preparation: Provide an explicit test slow log path writable by mysqld.
Add evaluator support for file existence and open deleted inode evidence if this should be judged automatically.

success_criteria.manual_check: slow log path disappears after unlink and reappears after FLUSH SLOW LOGS

metadata.current_graph_gap: No dedicated log_rotation or observability_overhead node exists.

posts.problem: Slow log records fast queries because log_queries_not_using_indexes is enabled.
required_preparation: Create items without a useful index on category or description.
Add evaluator support for slow log entry parsing if automatic hit judgment is needed.

actions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE description LIKE '%dbmags_non_indexed_probe%'

success_criteria.manual_check: fast full-scan queries appear in slow log due to log_queries_not_using_indexes

posts.problem: Application query is slow because LOWER(subject) LIKE '%...%' and dependent permission subqueries force large scans under concurrency.
required_preparation: Create issues, projects, enabled_modules, members and users tables.
Do not create a fulltext/functional index that would remove the leading-wildcard scan.

actions.sql: SELECT i.* FROM issues AS i INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE p.status <> 9 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enabled_modules AS em WHERE em.project_id = p.id AND em.name = 'issue_tracking') AND i.id <> 251880 AND LOWER(i.subject) LIKE LOWER('%255392%') ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 10

posts.problem: SQL Server view uses correlated latest-per-group subquery and missing composite index, causing slow plan.
missing_capabilities: SQL Server connection/runtime config.
SQL Server executor for T-SQL batches, schemabinding views, SET STATISTICS IO/TIME and showplan collection.
SQL Server synthetic data loader.
SQL Server evaluator for logical reads and plan operators.

closest_current_task_shape.why_not_enough: The executor can send SQL to MySQL only; SQL Server view syntax and optimizer behavior cannot be reproduced accurately in MySQL.

posts.problem: SQL Server backup/read throughput drops after reboot/configuration change, ultimately tied to MAXDOP/parallelism.
missing_capabilities: SQL Server 2008 R2 or compatible SQL Server lab instance.
Large SQL Server database or controlled backup-size fixture.
Executor for sp_configure, BACKUP DATABASE TO DISK='NUL', PerfMon/wait-stat collection.
Evaluator for backup throughput, wait stats and IO latency.
Safe rollback of instance-level MAXDOP changes.

closest_current_task_shape.why_not_enough: Current logical_backup_command can run argv commands such as mysqldump, not SQL Server BACKUP DATABASE or instance-level MAXDOP experiments.

posts.problem: INSERT...SELECT with LEFT JOIN to a derived table examines huge row counts because useful indexes are missing.
required_preparation: Create bot_sessions and bot_sessions_statistics in a disposable MySQL database.
Load enough synthetic rows to make today buckets large.
Avoid secondary indexes on member_id, latest_renewal and date_active for the anomalous run.

actions.sql: INSERT INTO bot_sessions_statistics (member_id, session_token, username, ip_address) SELECT s.member_id, s.session_token, s.username, s.ip_address FROM bot_sessions AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT st.member_id, st.session_token, st.username, st.ip_address FROM bot_sessions_statistics AS st WHERE st.date_active >= DATE(NOW())) AS st ON s.member_id = st.member_id WHERE s.latest_renewal >= DATE(NOW()) AND st.member_id IS NULL

posts.problem: SQL Server IF EXISTS introduces a row goal and changes the plan from parallel hash anti-join to nested loops.
missing_capabilities: SQL Server executor and data loader.
Plan collection with actual execution plans or SHOWPLAN XML.
Evaluator for row-goal/nested-loops/parallelism evidence.
SQL Server-specific request schema for optimizer plan regression nodes.

closest_current_task_shape.why_not_enough: MySQL cannot reproduce SQL Server row-goal optimizer behavior from IF EXISTS.
